entries.title: A card you replied under comes back only when its crewmate is done
entries.body: A card you replied under or put aside could come back while its crewmate was still updating it, so you saw a stale version. It now comes back once, when the crewmate finishes, showing its latest words. New cards still appear as soon as a crewmate reports them.
entries.noPicture: The card looks the same; what changes is when it comes back, which a still picture cannot show.
